items.title: FDA issues early alert for Edwards Lifesciences’ mitral valve delivery system after reported death, injury
items.summary: The FDA has issued an early alert for certain delivery systems used with Edwards Lifesciences’ SAPIEN M3 transcatheter mitral valve replacement system amid serious safety concerns.

items.title: Lilly's obesity pill, RevMed's pancreatic cancer breakthrough among slew of CHMP endorsements in Europe
items.summary: Across the pond, European regulators handed down a pair of pivotal approval recommendations this week, making way for a new front in Novo and Eli Lilly’s oral GLP-1 showdown and endorsing Revolution Medicines’ potential pancreatic cancer game changer.

items.title: Drugmakers, PhRMA seek to intervene in hospitals' 340B rebate challenge
items.summary: The American Hospital Association and others have launched a legal rematch with the federal government over the second iteration of a pilot program swapping out safety-net hospitals’ upfront drug discounts for after-the-fact rebates.

items.title: Ultragenyx makes swift $413M return on FDA review vouchers after summer of gene therapy nods
items.summary: Hot off a pair of key FDA approvals this summer, rare disease specialist Ultragenyx has wasted little time cashing in on the priority review vouchers it earned from the green lights.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Pierre Fabre's Ebvallo takes 3rd run at FDA approval
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: Clinical trial applications advice pilot becomes permanent
items.summary: The Accelerating Clinical Trials in the EU (ACT EU) advice pilot, which helps sponsors prepare clinical trial applications, will become a permanent initiative from January 2027…

items.title: SimBioSys nabs FDA clearance for Nvidia-powered, MRI-derived breast cancer recurrence tool
items.summary: SimBioSys has been given FDA clearance of the Nvidia-powered TumorSight Risk, an AI and MRI-derived prognostic tool for assessing the risk of a breast cancer coming back.

items.title: Vanda pauses social anxiety program after ex-Novartis asset flunks phase 3 study
items.summary: A phase 3 trial of Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ social anxiety disorder drug candidate has missed its primary endpoint, prompting the company to put the program on hold.

items.title: Trump's pharma holdings surged as drugmakers benefited from Medicare price negotiation carveouts, Democrats allege
items.summary: As midterms loom, Democrats on Congress’ Joint Economic Committee (JEC) are reviving concerns about the orphan drug carveout tucked into Republicans’ One Big Beautiful Bill Act, alleging that President Donald Trump accumulated millions of dollars in pharma stocks before and after the enactment of policies benefiting some of those same companies.

items.title: Roche makes class-first push into thyroid eye disease with new FDA nod for Enspryng
items.summary: Some six years after scoring an initial FDA nod, Roche’s IL-6 receptor inhibitor Enspryng is muscling up to Amgen's Tepezza in a key eye disease arena.

items.title: FDA clears ImmunityBio’s Anktiva expansion in bladder cancer after regulatory whiplash
items.summary: To expand Anktiva’s label, the FDA adopted a new approach to how it evaluates treatments for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC. The new regulatory path essentially allowed ImmunityBio to bypass an expensive randomized phase 3 trial that competitor Johnson & Johnson is currently forced to grind through.

items.title: China looks to ban foreign acquisitions of critical biopharma platforms
items.summary: As Washington ramps up efforts to tighten cross-border life sciences deals involving Chinese assets, Beijing is moving to tighten its own grip on biomedical innovation, rolling out a draft policy that would ban or restrict the export of key biopharmaceutical technologies.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Bausch + Lomb's returning CEO Saunders exits again
items.summary: Bausch + Lomb CEO Brent Saunders is making a second exit from the eye health company, as the president of parent Bausch Health steps in temporarily. Plus, Paragon Labs is buying out Apogee talent after its acquisition by AbbVie.

items.title: Galderma bulks up dermatology portfolio with $1.5B acquisition of Zo Skin Health
items.summary: Expanding its presence in dermatology, Cetaphil maker Galderma has agreed to acquire professional skincare shop Zo Skin Health for $1.5 billion.

items.title: Osivax focuses on combo strategy for flu vaccine after phase 2 fail
items.summary: Osivax has been forced to narrow the strategy for its influenza vaccine after the shot failed a phase 2b study.

items.title: With new Omvoh analyses, Lilly argues 'higher bar' for IBD treatment is within reach
items.summary: In the fiercely competitive inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) market, Eli Lilly is making the case for its antibody Omvoh as a holistic solution for patients living with ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease—and one that could offer relief after other biologic drugs have failed, too.

items.title: ‘It’s certainly not easy’: How are Boston biotechs coping with a shallower pool of seed funding?
items.summary: As the world's biggest biotech hub, funding for early-stage startups has long been the lifeblood of Boston's life sciences industry. But the latest figures make for concerning reading—with average seed funding secured by a preclinical start-up plunging 40% over the past year.

items.title: Labcorp, Thrive Global launch latest Thrive 5 health test
items.summary: Labcorp has launched the Thrive 5 Health Test that is now offered through a collaboration with Arianna Huffington's behavior change technology company, Thrive Global.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Estuary channels $93M series A; OMass obtains $310M
items.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

items.title: Estuary flows out of stealth with $103M to propel kidney disease gene therapies into clinic
items.summary: Estuary Biotherapeutics has swum out of stealth with $103 million in funding to power a pair of gene therapies into clinical trials for an inherited kidney disorder.

items.title: City goes public with $200M IPO, while Frazier Life Sciences takes biotech-focused SPAC to Nasdaq
items.summary: City Therapeutics has gone public with an upsized $200 million IPO, on the same day that Frazier Life Sciences listed its second biotech-focused shell company.

items.title: OrbiMed’s largest-ever Asian fund contributes to $3B war chest
items.summary: OrbiMed has raised $3 billion to place a fresh round of bets on biotechs and life sciences companies in the U.S., Europe and Asia.

items.title: AstraZeneca inks $1.5B insitro deal for AI-enabled target discovery of liver, heart disease drugs
items.summary: AstraZeneca is paying insitro $40 million upfront to find novel drug targets for liver and heart diseases using artificial intelligence.

items.title: Rebranded Galapagos finally finds buyer for unwanted cell therapy pipeline
items.summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics—the new name for Belgium’s Galapagos Therapeutics—has found a buyer for its unwanted cell therapy pipeline.

items.title: Iambic goes public with $150M IPO to accelerate clinical development of oncology pipeline
items.summary: Iambic Therapeutics’ IPO came in dead on target, bringing in $150 million for the AI biotech to fuel the clinical development of its oncology pipeline.

items.title: Why OMass’ $310M series C marks ‘fantastic milestone’ on journey to become ‘Britain’s Big Biotech’
items.summary: When Fierce last caught up with OMass Therapeutics’ CEO Ros Deegan, it was hard not to be impressed by the company’s ambition.

items.title: IQVIA, Veeva expand on existing partnership for speedier clinical trials
items.summary: Clinical research giant IQVIA and cloud system provider Veeva Systems have expanded their partnership to further increase trial speed and efficiency.

items.title: Merck KGaA spinout iOnctura touts PI3K delta inhibitor in metastatic eye cancer
items.summary: iOnctura’s PI3K delta inhibitor shows promise in phase 1 study in patients with mostly pre-treated metastatic melanoma.

items.title: Verastem CEO claims RAS drug has 'set a new benchmark' for tricky cancer in early readout
items.summary: Verastem Oncology's decision to refocus its R&D efforts on its KRAS inhibitor appears to be paying off, at least based on initial data from a phase 1/2 trial.

items.title: Deep-pocketed Verdiva axes GLP-1 switching trial over ‘market evolution’
items.summary: Verdiva Bio has scrapped a phase 2 trial of its once-weekly oral GLP-1 drug candidate VRB-101, pulling the plug the year after launching with $410 million.
